Declared Age Range is Apple's framework for age assurance. When users or parents choose to share age information, the Declared Age Range API can return age bands or categories plus eligibility signals for age-gated features. Age Range for Apps lets Family Sharing parents manage whether children share age ranges with apps. AppLocale rewrites how you describe that story on the App Store product page in zh-Hans — we do not implement the API in buyer apps.
